metadata.title: Performance — SharpTS
metadata.description: Compare compiled SharpTS with Node.js and inspect compiler and desktop performance evidence.

title: TypeScript at .NET speed
subtitle: Reproducible benchmark evidence from the pinned SharpTS revision, led by the target that matters most: meeting or exceeding Node.js.

comparison.title: SharpTS vs Node.js
comparison.description: Each row compares the same TypeScript workload in the same run environment. The chart uses a logarithmic scale so unusually large wins or gaps do not hide ordinary results.
comparison.ratioExplanation: Relative speed is Node mean ÷ SharpTS mean. Values above 1× favor SharpTS; 0.95×–1.05× is treated as practical parity.

compiler.title: Compiler headroom
compiler.description: SharpTS-compiled TypeScript compared with equivalent dynamic C# and idiomatic C# within each BenchmarkDotNet run.
compiler.empty: No reviewed compiler-micro snapshot is checked into this SharpTS revision yet. The dashboard is ready for the next published schema-v2 run.

desktop.title: Desktop performance budgets
desktop.description: GUI latency, allocation, startup, memory, and shipping-size evidence stays separate from the Node comparison.
desktop.empty: No reviewed GUI snapshot is checked into this SharpTS revision yet. Missing evidence is never shown as zero or as a passing budget.

methodology.title: Methodology and provenance
methodology.description: Absolute measurements are only compared inside one machine-bound run. Different suites and environments are never combined.
